behaviors_asserted: ClientResponse types assume native fetch behavior (res.ok, res.json(), res.text())
ofetch throws errors on non-2xx responses instead of returning a response object with ok: false
axios responses use a data property instead of methods like .json()
TypeScript does not know that non-2xx responses will never arrive as normal response objects when using ofetch
Users must create type workarounds like res200() for every RPC call
